lead.headline: Tuten still in the FLEX — Gordon in before 19:15
lead.deck: No practice all week and no ruling yet; Wilson still in the protocol; three coin flips unset.
lead.body: The bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten, in the FLEX, missed every practice this week with the ankle and foot, and no player in Liam Coen's Jacksonville tenure who did that has been active. He locks when Jacksonville kick off at Baltimore at 19:15 tonight; no insider had ruled on him by 15:00Z. Gordon projects 16.5 to his 15.4 — a coin flip the projection takes, and the practice record points the same way. Garrett Wilson, in a WR slot, is still in the concussion protocol, and Rice projects higher anyway. Likely over Loveland is the third coin flip. Jonathan Taylor has not been traded, and any deal would land after Sunday. Nothing on the wire is worth IPADE priority.
